question: Should a cookie-read result retain permission warnings from inaccessible Chromium roots when another root successfully yields cookies?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes observable warnings on partial success; whether downstream callers should treat that as actionable is a compatibility policy choice that source review alone cannot resolve.

options.title: Preserve partial-success warnings
options.body: Merge the change and document that returned cookies may be accompanied by warnings from inaccessible browser roots.

options.title: Warn only on complete discovery failure
options.body: Keep prior partial-success behavior and return discovery warnings only when scanning finds no usable cookie database.

recommendation.title: Preserve partial-success warnings
recommendation.body: Merge the change and document that returned cookies may be accompanied by warnings from inaccessible browser roots.
